test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4a6a72c70966a11342ec81a169a4754e8680c82357d69a9071dc557bdcd8904.png]
solution:
Given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/260a5bfa4f9d761595d386b49a71dab8661696160ce3c373873ebf3b8e26007e.png] 

The logic here is: The mirror image of the odd box image is shown in the even box image. And also another image with 90 degree clockwise direction turn is added in the even box image.

1) The mirror image of this shape [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/073efe5a1a18c75e8dc61a7c26644446fa71dd04fec0b6a62422fb47deaf1fa1.png] is shown in the next image [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a473fd945f5828debd8a0d8f800bcb57a37527b56eec78319b923a23bc84b4.png] . Along with this, this mirror image is turned with 90 degree clockwise direction.

2) Similarly the mirror image of the shape [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3179bba1b729c80bd92be2a5c303830f1b0ef3ca2ee82d23723d99a8dad21ea6.png] is shown in the next image ( [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5888b5a92a94af0f92d97baedfc042d3a665698f3e4619086c15207380173c8.png] ). and then it is turned 90 degree i.e. . [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/049d30fe51bc623e1a808ec8589b2885e4ae024bcbc137fb3d0cc8067c80c110.png] 

Thus, the next image will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f7cb6c046f3b54ff68dc9d9f62f6fddea571b6d009ee56056fce3463d708798.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 4**__'.
